content.text: Other projects from fcrepo4-labs still need to be added
Are there other projects to be added to this ticket?
I would note, however, that travis does not appear to be enabled for a number of these projects, including:
the two authZ modules, and the message-consumer
(at least those last three haven't been run in travis in about ~11 months)
All of the PRs mentioned in this ticket have been merged with their respective master branches.
Also, the two AuthZ modules now have travis enabled. Storage-policy and message-consumer are left as-is.
, could you please merge the following:
the fcrepo-build-tools PR has been merged with master
Now that the fcrepo pom configuration specifies java8 as a build target, the .travis.yml configuration on the various downstream projects should be updated.
